title: Recall the Impulse-Momentum Theorem
text: Impulse equals the change in momentum: $$J = \Delta p = m \Delta v = m(v_f - v_i)$$

title: Convert Units
text: Convert the mass from grams to kilograms: 150 g = 0.15 kg. Always use SI units in physics calculations.

title: Substitute Values
text: Substitute: Impulse = 0.15 kg x (20 m/s - 0 m/s) = 0.15 x 20 = 3 kg.m/s
